newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-PRICE PLANNING TO PLAY IN BRITISH OPEN.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-PRICE PLANNING TO PLAY IN BRITISH OPEN.

text.p: Nick Price, winner of three major championships, expects to play in the British Open at Royal Troon starting a week from Thursday despite pulling out of this week's Western Open due to tendinitis in his left shoulder.
Price, who withdrew before Thursday's opening round, remained at the Cog Hill course for treatment before leaving Saturday to fly home to Florida.
Before departing, Price indicated to reporters he was a sure starter at Troon, where he finished second in the 1982 British Open.
Price said he had withdrawn from the Western Open as a precautionary measure.
The Zimbabwean said he did not know exactly what had caused the injury, but suspected it might have been a practice drill in which he has been driving while holding the club with just his left hand.
